subject: AWS Marketplace listing — product page & co-sell materials
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing — product page & co-sell materials

Hi team,

Following up on our marketplace kickoff — AWS asked for final product page copy, pricing descriptors, and co-sell collateral by EOD Thursday so they can queue the listing review and assign a co-sell rep. I attached the current draft of the product page and a zip of the hero images.

Can you please:
- Jonas: do a technical accuracy pass on the capabilities bullets and the resource requirements table (esp. Dedicated vs. Hosted notes).
- Alex: scrub the pricing/units copy to match our public docs and add a short blurb about Dedicated capacity pricing (monthly commit).

Attachments: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx (draft product page, comments enabled), product_images.zip (hero/thumbnail sizes)

Goal: ship a version that meets AWS Marketplace basic content checklist and calls out co-sell benefits (qualified pipeline, marketing support). If we can get this to them before EOD Thurs (2026-02-12), AWS will sync us with a Channel Manager and start the co-sell intake.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — product page & co-sell materials

Marissa,

Thanks — I took a pass and enforced the product -> benefits -> how it works flow. Key edits (see inline comments in aws_listing_draft_v3.docx):
- Shortened the hero copy to a single sentence + 3 bullets; removed platform-level implementation details from the hero.
- Corrected Dedicated capacity details: "Reserved GPU pools with SLA-backed throughput" and clarified autoscale behavior.
- Added a short sentence on data isolation & VPC options for regulated customers (this is important for marketplace customers looking for compliance).

Checklist for AWS submission (my suggestion):
1) Hero one-liner + 3 bullets (done)
2) Pricing blurb consistent with public pricing page (Alex to confirm)
3) 1–2 screenshots + 2–3 architecture diagrams (we only have hero images now; product team to export infra diagrams)
4) Co-sell / GTM benefits section (who to loop at AWS, expected lead handoff process)
5) Contact & trial: include dedicated contact and clear trial SKUs (we should avoid listing internal SKU numbers)

I attached a marked-up doc and a quick co-sell checklist.

Attachment: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx (Jonas-edits), co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf (checklist & ask list)

- Jonas
Lead, Solutions & Integrations
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Support <aws-partner-support@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — product page & co-sell materials

Hi Marissa — thanks for the heads up and the draft. Quick notes from the Marketplace intake side:

- We need: product summary (<= 300 chars), full description (<= 4,000 chars), three feature bullets, at least 1 architecture diagram (PNG/SVG), pricing descriptor (on-demand + reserved if you support it), and a support contact.
- For co-sell activation: provide a one-page GTM summary and expected commit level (monthly $) so we can route to the right Partner Development Rep.
- Security/compliance callout: add a short SOC 2 / data residency statement if applicable (this helps faster approval for enterprise customers).

I've provisionally assigned listing intake ID AMKT-2367 and created a Partner Central draft here: https://partnercentral.aws.amazon.com/partners/12345/listings/rdw-inference.

Next steps: please upload the final assets to the Partner Central draft and confirm the committed offer (if any). Once uploaded, I can move the intake to review and introduce the PDR. DocuSign for the listing agreement will follow once review passes — I'll include that link in my next note.

Cheers,
Sara Nguyen
AWS Marketplace Intake
sara.nguyen@amazon.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@amazon.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Support <aws-partner-support@amazon.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — product page & co-sell materials

Sara / team — attaching final assets for the Partner Central draft. Per checklist above we've trimmed the hero, added SOC 2 callout, and included a one-page GTM summary that outlines target segments, expected quarterly pipeline, and preferred PDR contact cadence.

Attachments to upload: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx (final, no comments), product_images.zip (hero + thumbnails), co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf (GTM one-pager + lead handoff).

Alex confirmed the pricing blurb — on-demand token pricing is listed; Dedicated commit blurb remains intentionally non-public but includes the minimum monthly commit threshold for PDR routing. Jonas, please follow up with the product team for the architecture PNG that Sara asked for (I've CC'd Alex for any procurement notes).

If you need anything else to move this to review, let me know. Otherwise please proceed with review and DocuSign for the listing agreement.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
